name: @transcodes-guard/core
description: Host-agnostic public core of transcodes-guard — the former gate-contract (contract/), stepup-core (stepup/), mcp-server-core (server/), danger-patterns (patterns/), hook-adapters (hosts/) and plugin-paths (paths/) packages, consolidated into one workspace package with per-domain subpath exports. The backend stays behind getGateBackend(); only @transcodes-guard/gate-backend remains a separate package (import-firewalled, separate CDN bundle unit).

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/patterns/data && cp src/patterns/data/*.json dist/patterns/data/
